model_info.name: mobilenet_face_embed_112_qdq_int8_rgb Face Embedding Model (ONNX QDQ Int8, RGB input)
model_info.description: MobileFaceNet-class face embedding (512-d, L2-normalized by pp_face_embed) for the NE302 dual-model engine: Model A (face detection) crops faces, this Model B extracts templates matched locally against the on-device face database. Normalization (x-127.5)/127.5 is embedded in the graph; input is raw RGB888 uint8. Prepared by Script/prepare_face_embed_model.py.
model_info.author: insightface (w600k_mbf) via NE302 preparation script
